about.title: About me
about.lead: I automate business processes and build the software that runs them.
about.body: For six years I have been turning manual, spreadsheet-driven operations into systems people actually use. Most of my work starts the same way: a business is growing, the old way of tracking things has stopped working, and nobody trusts the numbers any more. I map how the work really happens, then build the smallest system that fixes it — and keep improving it once it is live.
about.closing: If something in your business runs on memory, paper or a spreadsheet nobody else understands, that is usually where I start.
